site_og_description: Open-source agentic harness. Keep looping your prompt with an LLM until the appropriate outcome is achieved.
seo_signin_desc: Welcome back. Sign in to manage models and config.
seo_signup_desc: Sign up to access the admin portal and manage your Kaja setup.
seo_reset_password_desc: Choose a new password for your account.
hero_quote: Your terminal should talk by asking — never by guessing
hero_paragraph_1: Kaja is an open-source agentic harness. Based on your input, keep running an LLM with its findings again and again until the appropriate outcome (🙏).
hero_paragraph_2: It's a state machine, driven by skilled AI models for various tasks (including image generation and speech), with local and online tools.
why_kaja_feature_models_desc: OpenAI compatible — Ollama, Fireworks, Ministral, MiniMax M3, and more
why_kaja_feature_voice_desc: Mic dictation and TTS via speaches, toggle with Ctrl+T
why_kaja_feature_widgets_desc: Embeddable UI components for seamless AI integration
why_kaja_feature_personas_desc: The assistant switches its behaviours and tweaks model settings based on the context
why_kaja_feature_tools_desc: Brave web search, location lookups, and more as config groups
why_kaja_feature_telegram_desc: Kaja telegram runs the same personas, tools and models as a bot
personas_description: Each persona is a .toml file: a label, its system-prompt instructions, and an optional when clause. Kaja reads the room and switches personas mid-conversation on its own — no command needed.
personas_default_when: no other persona clearly fits the conversation
personas_barkochba_when: the user wants to play a guessing game / twenty questions
personas_care_when: the user talks about their day, feelings, mood, or personal struggles
personas_onboarding_when: a new user should be walked through the initial getting-to-know-you questions
memory_description: How Kaja remembers you, across chats and sessions.
memory_persistent_desc: Kaja remembers key facts about you and recalls them later, so you never repeat yourself. — Mark the important ones sticky to keep them in every conversation.
memory_dataset_desc: Some personas monitor a conversation for a set of fields and gently repeat their questions — even day after day — until every one is filled in.
configuration_meta_link: Have a favourite MCP or skill?
configuration_description: Easily extendable plain files. Fetch templates during onboarding and edit them by hand if tweaking is necessary.
configuration_tool_ip2geo_desc: Convert IP to city level location
configuration_tool_current_time_desc: Current date/time in any IANA timezone
configuration_tool_fetch_url_desc: Fetch a URL and extract to text
configuration_tool_web_search_desc: Location based web search via Brave API
configuration_tool_generate_image_desc: Generate an image from a prompt
install_description: Only tested on Linux. A setup wizard walks you through config on first launch (or anytime config is missing/invalid) — no separate step needed.
install_instruction: Paste the appropriate command in your terminal, press Enter to install:
install_binary_suffix: — Linux, macOS, and Windows, x64 and arm64.
barkochba_idle_prompt: Think of something. You get {maxQuestions} questions — answer by clicking a button below.
barkochba_error_rate_limited: Too many messages — please wait a moment.
barkochba_error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
